x: Humayun brought the Persian masters Mir Sayyid Ali and Abdus Samad, who founded the Mughal school (statements 1 and 2). Basawan was an Akbar-era master and Ustad Mansur a painter of Jahangir's court, so neither was brought by Humayun.

Pair D is wrong: Baz Bahadur was the Sultan of Malwa (famed with Rupmati), who served Akbar only after Akbar's forces defeated him in 1561, not from the start of his career. Baiju Bawra sang at Raja Man Singh Tomar's court, and Mian ki Malhar and Darbari Kanada are Tansen's ragas.

Pair A is wrong: Keshavdas of the Orchha court wrote Ramchandrika, Kavipriya, Rasikpriya and Ratan Bavani, not Ram Rasayan (the MPPSC 2025 trap). Tulsidas wrote Ramcharitmanas, Surdas Sur Sagar and Kavindracharya Saraswati Kavindra-kalpalata.
All three statements are correct. Safdar Jung, Saadat Khan's nephew and son-in-law, succeeded him as Nawab of Awadh and also became Wazir; his successor Shuja-ud-Daula fought at Buxar.
